phases.focus: Weigh in, set up food logging, walk every day.

phases.name: Rebuild
phases.focus: Log every bite, weigh in most mornings, one hard session on Tuesday.

phases.name: Build
phases.focus: Two hard sessions, calories set from your calibrated burn, hold through the holidays.

phases.name: Push
phases.focus: Full volume. Every week counts toward 78 kg.

Sun.session: Long walk or hike outside, 60 min+

rules: Weigh in after the bathroom, before food or water.
During Rebuild, log every bite in MyFitnessPal (linked to Garmin Connect).
Behind step pace at 3 PM: 20-minute walk after dinner. No debate.
Readiness red (HRV low or body battery peak under 50): swap the hard session for an easy one and move it to the next day.
Never miss twice. One bad day is noise, two is a pattern.
